title: UneceAllergy
description:
A guest condition of the abnormal reaction of the body to a previously encountered substance introduced by inhalation,
ingestion, injection, or skin contact.

description.description: A textual description of this guest allergy.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, of this guest allergy.

restriction.description: A restriction, expressed as text, related to this guest allergy.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of guest allergy.
